items.why: Stage 2: crafted at the Worktable from amethyst shards and Resonant Brass under vftv:singing_wands, before any Echo part exists.
Found in ancient city chests deep under the Deep Dark; reachable with Stage 1-2 tools and no magic at all.
Mined from amethyst geodes from the very start of Stage 1.

aspects.why: Amethyst shards and Resonant Brass dissolve into Sonus in a crucible (Stage 2).
Rabbit's feet and the mod's tuned parts dissolve into Praecantatio in a crucible (Stage 2).
Amethyst shards, quartz and glass dissolve into Vitreus in a crucible (Stage 2).
